newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile school wall collapse kills two children.
newsitem.headline: Chile school wall collapse kills two children.

text.p: A wall collapsed at a special school in Valparaiso, killing two children and leaving three others missing, police said on Wednesday.
One of the victims was a 12-year old girl who went to meet her sister, who was a pupil at the school 120 kilometres (72 miles) west of Santiago.
Police did not know the identity of the other child who died when a wall of a building at the Cenimes special school caved in. Five others were hospitalized.
